findings.text: §12's done-when asserts "the board's context-use read for that transcript returns the last whole request rather than raising", but on a fixture of whole assistant lines followed by one torn last line the board read already returns that request at the base: `_last_assistant_request` reads the tail as bytes and its `except ValueError` catches the torn line's UnicodeDecodeError (a ValueError subclass, reckon/crew/directory.py:150-153), and the forward read through `_jsonl_events` is reached only when the file exceeds the largest tail size of 4 MiB (reckon/crew/directory.py:41,141-167). Measured at base on a 90-byte torn transcript: `_jsonl_events` raised UnicodeDecodeError, `_last_assistant_request` returned `{'tokens': {'input_tokens': 5, ...}}` — so that assertion passes unchanged at the base and the test fails there only on the direct `_jsonl_events` arm.
